headline: The market, in brief
note:
Fall is typically when inventory peaks around Greater Boston, which gives buyers more homes to choose from and puts more pressure on sellers to price right from day one. Across Massachusetts, prices have held steady to slightly up this year.

Thinking about buying or selling in the new year? Now is a great time to start planning.
